# nautobot_vlan_group (Resource)

Manages a VLAN group in Nautobot.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nautobot_vlan_group" "example" {
  name        = "Campus VLANs"
  description = "VLANs used on the campus network"
  range       = "1-999,1100-4094"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) VLAN group name.

### Optional

- `description` (String) VLAN group description.
- `location_id` (String) UUID of the location associated with the VLAN group.
- `range` (String) Permitted VLAN IDs as a comma-separated list of individual IDs or ranges. Defaults to `1-4094`.
- `tags_ids` (List of String) UUIDs of tags associated with the VLAN group.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) VLAN group creation date (RFC3339).
- `id` (String) VLAN group UUID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import nautobot_vlan_group.example 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
